The backend uses `Tool` directly in these classes, functions and methods. I found them by searching all of `mealie/` for the name `Tool`. I did not read the code around every hit, so a use under a different spelling (for example an alias import) would have been missed.

**Relationships to `Tool`** (declared on the owning class):
- `Household` has `tools_on_hand`, a `relationship("Tool", ...)`.
- `CookBook` has `tools`, a `relationship(Tool, ...)`.
- `Group` has `tools`, a `relationship("Tool", ...)`.
- `RecipeModel` has `tools`, a `relationship("Tool", ...)`.

**Base-class type parameter:**
- `RepositoryTools` names `Tool` in `GroupRepositoryGeneric[RecipeToolOut, Tool]`.

- `RepositoryTools._query` uses `Tool.id`, `.correlate(Tool)` and `with_expression(Tool.recipe_count, ...)`.
- `RepositoryTools.get_empty` runs `select(Tool)` and filters on `Tool.recipes`.
- `RepositoryFactory.tools` (the `tools` property) passes `Tool` as an argument to `RepositoryTools(...)`. I did not check the factory class name, which I took to be `AllRepositories`.
- `RepositoryHousehold.statistics` passes `Tool` as an argument to `model_count(Tool, ...)`.
- `RepositoryRecipes.update` has a dict `{"tags": Tag, "recipe_category": Category, "tools": Tool}`.
- `RepositoryRecipes.page_all` passes `Tool` to `self._uuids_for_items(tools, Tool)`.
- `RepositoryRecipes._build_recipe_filter` uses `Tool.id == tool_id` and `Tool.id.in_(tools)`.
- `RecipeSuggestionMixin.find_suggested_recipes` calls `orm.aliased(Tool)`.
- `RecipeToolOut.loader_options` uses `selectinload(Tool.households_with_tool)`.
- `RecipeToolResponse.loader_options` uses `selectinload(Tool.recipes)` and `selectinload(Tool.households_with_tool)`.

I left out `RepositoryRecipes._resolve_organizer`. It mentions `Tool` only in a type annotation, which you said not to count.
